description: Terminal-Bench style PKI drill: verify three server certificates (good chain, wrong host for api.internal, self-signed) against the root + intermediate in certs/ with hostname checking, and write report/tls-report.txt with the true openssl result keyword, SAN, CN and issuer CN per certificate; the gate re-runs openssl and compares every field. Needs openssl on PATH and in the run's --auto-approve (not in the default set).

criteria: Every leaf has a report block whose result keyword, SAN list, CN and issuer CN match what openssl verify (chain + hostname api.internal) and x509 -text actually report against the certs/ bundle, and nothing under certs/, the docs or the gate changed.
